meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude Code 会在回复前自动浮现相关记忆,每轮结束把新洞见写入记忆图谱;记忆存在每个 agent group 的 .claude/ 挂载里,容器重启后依然保留。
howto.when: 只对使用默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 生效;若某组的 provider 被设成 opencode 等其他值,注册的 hooks 不会运行。

say.text: 帮这个 agent group 装上 mnemon 持久记忆
检查一下 mnemon hooks 有没有注册成功
say.note: 会查看容器内 settings.json 里的 hooks

say.text: 重置这个 agent 的全部记忆
say.note: 停容器并删除主机上的 mnemon/ 目录

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude Code recalls relevant past context before responding and stores new insights after each turn, through hooks mnemon setup registers at container start. Memory lives in each agent group's .claude/ mount and survives restarts.
howto.when_en: Fires only on agent groups running the default Claude provider (absent or "claude" in container.json). If a group sets another provider such as opencode, the registered hooks do not run.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory on this agent group
say_en.note: Edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds the image

say_en.text: Check whether the mnemon hooks are registered
say_en.note: Inspects settings.json inside the running container

say_en.text: Reset all memory for this agent
say_en.note: Stops the container and deletes the host mnemon/ directory
